sections.text: A storm has darkened the last working lighthouse on the coast. A ship sounds its horn beyond the reef.

consequence.text: A wave throws you against the stone steps.

sections.text: Halfway up, the stair divides. A broken ladder leads directly to the lamp, while a covered landing offers shelter.

consequence.text: A rung snaps beneath your foot.
Shelter from the storm helps you recover.

sections.text: A maintenance passage climbs inside the tower. A rescue boat could also carry you back to the harbor.

options.description: Return to harbor in the rescue boat

sections.text: The keeper's instructions show how to relight the lamp. A service door also leads back toward the shore.

options.description: Follow the instructions to the lamp

sections.text: The lamp can be lit from the protected control wheel. Outside, an unsecured cable might turn the lens more quickly.

consequence.text: The cable tears free and throws you from the platform.

sections.text: The beacon sweeps across the reef. The ship answers with three short blasts and turns toward safe water.
The harbor crew receives your warning and prepares rescue boats for the ships still outside.
